Combat: fight director.script: (function(){const S=["Hold on the foe this turn: their face, footwork or Quirk as they decide.", "Go wide first: what the fight is doing to the place (glass, signs, dust, water).", "Stay tight on the player character's body: hands, breath, the Quirk starting in them.", "Cut once to someone already at risk (a hostage, a child, a fallen ally) and back.", "Use sound: the hit, a siren, a crowd going silent.", "Use the place: something already in it changes this exchange (cover, footing, a thing thrown or broken).", "Slow one instant down: the moment just before contact.", "Show the cost already paid: Strain or a Drawback in the player character's body, or damage they caused."];const tk=check({type:'game-tick'})||0;const i=tk%S.length,side=tk%3!==0?'No optional ally or bystander dialogue and no reaction cutaways this turn.':'At most one brief ally or bystander line this turn, only if it adds something new.';effects.push({type:'story',instruction:'FIGHT DIRECTION (narrator only, while an exchange is underway): '+side+' Rescues, defense and answers the player asked for still happen. End on the unresolved exchange, not a comment or a filming image. Camera: '+S[i]+' Invent no danger, damage or cost for the shot. A Resisted result glances off or barely bites, whatever the roll is called. Never reuse an image, taunt, shout or beat from the last turn (no second "still standing"); a running joke or caption lands at most once per fight. A lasting look or stance (glowing eyes, raised hair, a guard planted in a doorway, a wound, dust) is named once, then only when it changes, never as a closing tag ("eyes still red"). A foe says at most one short line per exchange.'});log('director '+i+(tk%3!==0?' quiet':''));})();
